title: Parts of the native media player
blurb: The controls of <video> are a closed shadow tree. Restyle them with pseudo-elements, let :paused and :seeking drive a shader through CSS, and draw the controls as a layer apart from the picture.
question: The native media controls are a shadow tree a page cannot open. Can a canvas restyle their parts, react to the player's state, or draw the controls apart from the picture?
result: Pseudo-element rules are drawn. State pseudo-classes drive a shader through :has() where the browser has them. A video reduced to its controls can be drawn anywhere. No single part can be reached from script.
